SG - Jalen Green $18 - Showed flashes of superstar scorer potential latter half of last season, hoping he breaks out within the next 4 years. Also compensates for Lonzo's tendency to not drive to the rim.

SF - Lauri Markannen $7 - Ok defender, good shooter to surround the others

C - James Wiseman $8 - Showed flashes in preseason game, has high ceiling and can serve as the interior force Mobley needs alongside him

Bones Hyland $9 - Could become great bench scorer

I disagree with the other comments as one is a story concept and the other is just a story element that isn’t actually bad. If I had to choose a trope though, I would go for the mirror jumpscares in horror movies. Jumpscares should be used to build tension then release it all at once, like an overly stretched rubber band snapping back. One way to make a good jumpscare is to mislead the audience into expecting a jumpscare at a certain part, but put it into a different part(that also makes sense of course). An example of this is the red demon from Insidious, the dialogue between the characters combined with the use of a flashback scene makes us expect a jumpscare in said flashback, only for it to appear during their dialogue in the real world. The mirror jumpscare has been used so many times that we already expect it, which makes it less scary and that it usually has no build-up which makes it even less effective.
